name: Pinlet
ability: Keen Eye / Big Pecks / Cheek Pouch (hidden)
look: a round chick with a white face and belly, a red cap and tuft, big grey eyes with star glints, a small yellow beak, little raised brown wings and a stubby banded tail
entry: Pinlet chicks wait in the nest with their beaks wide open, shrieking until a Pinnant drops a berry in. The star-shaped glints in their eyes fade as they grow up.
how: Wild: common at pinbird nests (rocky crags topped with a great hay nest, in plains, meadows, savannas and windswept hills).
